page.overview:
What is Yomi?

Yomi (), also called "Yomi-No-Kuni" or "Land of the Dead", is the Shintoist version of the afterlife. It appears as a location in the TMNT franchise. In the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Adventures by Archie Comics, Noi Tai Dar and Vulvana are denizens of Yomi.

In , Ninjara, Naga, their grandmother, and temporarily hide there to elude a hunter, passing through a torii to arrive in Yomi. Much of the mini-series Shredder in Hell takes place in various areas of the Yomi, including "Hell".

During the Ujigami story arc, leaves the Yomi through a portal created by . Later, during a battle against Karai and , is kicked through a portal and lands in the Yomi, where he encounters his mother, Tang Shen.

The portal attracts a Gashadokuro, who leaves the Yomi through it in order to feed on the fear it senses from the other side. Tang Shen then fetches and leaves the Yomi as well, though Mikey is stuck there when the portal closes.
